messages:
maria (AE): Inbound SIG/CAIQ from HorizonHealth. They've asked for CAIQ + SOC2 report + confirmation on BYOK for POC. Who can own the questionnaire?
questionnaire-bot: New security intake submitted: HorizonHealth. Link: https://files.redwood.internal/qa/inq/HH-2026-03-18/CAIQ
tony (SE): I can coordinate the POC side (networking, env). Need deadline and whether they require Private or Dedicated.
maria (AE): Deadline = EOD Thu (customer timeline). They're evaluating private deployment + dedicated capacity as options.
ben (Security): @maria @tony I'll own the CAIQ answers. Need org CID and latest SOC2 artifact. Do we have a link to SOC2 report (redacted)?
sara (GTM Ops): FYI pricing note: Dedicated + BYOK will change quote, may need a contract addendum. @maria confirm if BYOK is a hard requirement for initial eval.
maria (AE): Customer said BYOK is preferred but they'd accept "customer-controlled keys via KMS integration" while POC runs in Dedicated. I'll confirm but treat as must-have for legal.
tony (SE): Quick status dump:
```
encrypt_at_rest: KMS (aws)
transport: TLS1.2+
kv_cache: disabled for POC
BYOK: supported in Private; Dedicated via partner HSM roadmap
```
ben (Security): For CAIQ rows ~2.4.3-2.4.5 I need the control owner names and evidence paths. Can someone drop links to confluence/artifacts?
maria (AE): SOC2 link: https://vault.redwood/invoices/soc2-redwood-redacted-2025.pdf (access: security-team). Confluence page: https://confluence.redwood/pages/INFR-CC-keys
tony (SE): Uploaded supporting network diagram + POC runbook to GH: https://github.com/redwood/poc-horizon/attachments
ben (Security): I'll draft answers and tag control owners. Expect a first pass by Wed 11:30am. @sara please hold off on quoting until we confirm BYOK wording.
sara (GTM Ops): Roger that. I'll start drafting quote scenarios (with/without BYOK) and include uplift for Dedicated HSM.
maria (AE): Also note: Horizon asked about data residency in EU. We need to confirm region for POC. @tony can you validate EU region availability for their tenant?
tony (SE): Confirmed EU region available for Dedicated and Hosted; Private requires customer infra. POC can run EU Dedicated if they commit to short term reservations.
ben (Security): One more ask — if we mention 'customer-managed keys' we need the exact flow. I'll add this snippet to answers, please confirm:
```
1) Customer provides KMS key ARN
2) Redwood binds key to customer tenant (Private/Dedicated)
3) Key access controls enforced via KMS IAM roles
```
maria (AE): @ben that's perfect. I'll confirm with Horizon that they can supply the KMS details. Target: draft CAIQ answers in thread by Thu EOD; Ben first pass Wed AM; Tony to upload any missing evidence by Wed EOD.
tony (SE): I'll upload the missing screenshots and a short certificate chain into the GH artifacts by Tue EOD.
ben (Security): Thanks. If anything blocks me, I'll @maria and escalate. :white_check_mark:
maria (AE): Great — assigning ownership: CAIQ answers -> ben, POC infra -> tony, pricing/quote -> sara. I'll update Salesforce and ping legal if they insist on BYOK language.
sara (GTM Ops): :thumbsup: I'll prepare two quote scenarios and flag any contractual changes.
questionnaire-bot: Intake status updated -> assigned_to: ben; due: 2026-03-26
maria (AE): Thanks team. I'll follow up with Horizon for final confirmation on BYOK and residency. Closing loop here unless anything urgent.
